datasets.description: Mozambique Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mozambique_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2021 across Mozambique. The classifications were spatially mapped and distributed in GeoJSON and KML formats, with attributes including IPC phase, scenario, collection date, and assistance eligibility status. This dataset represents post-event/current situation impact assessments of food insecurity conditions.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
